intro: Looking for your next escape? Tokyo delivers: neon, temples and the world's best food scene. Here is everything you need to plan a trip.

sections.heading: Why visit Tokyo
paragraphs: Tokyo (East Asia) is known for its city, food and culture experiences. Overall it is on the premium side — worth saving up for, though budget options exist.

sections.heading: Best time to go
paragraphs: The best time to visit is March to May and October to November.

sections.heading: Top things to do
list: Day trip to Mount Fuji area

sections.heading: How to get there
paragraphs: Direct flights from Delhi and Mumbai.

sections.heading: Insider tip
paragraphs: A prepaid IC card (Suica or Pasmo) makes trains effortless.

faq.q: When is the best time to visit Tokyo?
faq.a: March to May and October to November.
Direct flights from Delhi and Mumbai.

faq.q: Where should I stay in Tokyo?
faq.a: Popular choices: Shinjuku for transport; Asakusa for tradition; Shibuya for nightlife.
